https://rochdale.gov.uk/news/article/662.title: Sunshine and smiles: Dreams come true at Rochdale Feel Good Festival – Rochdale Borough Council
https://rochdale.gov.uk/news/article/662.snapshot: Sunshine and smiles: Dreams come true at Rochdale Feel Good Festival – Rochdale Borough Council Thousands packed Rochdale town centre in the summer sunshine. Thousands packed Rochdale town centre in the summer sunshine on Saturday, 8 August 2026 for Rochdale Feel Good Festival. The town centre was filled with a feast of music, food and entertainment for the Rochdale Development Agency organised event, headlined by 2-time BRIT Award winner and pop/soul icon Gabrielle, Ash and Starsailor. The town centre was busy from early afternoon, with large crowds gathering at the main stage on Rochdale Town Hall Square. Councillor Georgina Jacques, assistant cabinet member for communities and co-operation at Rochdale Borough Council, said: “Following the OMD Summer of Hits concert on Friday night Rochdale Feel Good Festival brought a day of superb live music to town. We had visitors from right across the UK, some visiting Rochdale for the first time, and feedback has been very positive. Gabrielle was amazing and I think her set was a fitting celebration by a much-loved star, with lots of 90s nostalgia and feel good vibes in a stunning setting. Thanks to everyone who came along, the staff and partners who helped deliver it, our wonderful volunteers and the security crew and of course everyone who bought tickets. Thank you all for your support. Rochdale Development Agency are looking at feedback and carrying out a thorough evaluation in the coming weeks.” Councillor Georgina Jacques, assistant cabinet member for communities and co-operation at Rochdale Borough Council. The main stage hosted by DJ Dave Sweetmore was opened by local 5-piece metal band Metro, who won this year's Rochdale Music Service Battle of the Bands competition. It was an impressive debut that got a great reception from the crowd for the young band, who only formed last year. The main stage was opened by local 5-piece metal band Metro, who won this year's Rochdale Music Service Battle of the Bands competition.
